relevance.rationale: *** WRONG JOIN ***. The seeded id points at a two-author textbook on basic hypergeometric series. The document is not a book at all: it is a single-author research preprint on connection formulae for local solutions of the Ramanujan equation (arXiv:1203.3404v1, math.CA). Type, authorship and date all differ. id set to null - no registered key matches (a grep for '1203.3404' in references.ts is empty, and the only entries under the same surname are for a different person working on quaternionic electroweak theory). CONSEQUENCE FOR THE SEEDED KEY: gasper-rahman-2004 is cited at QOU/QBeta/StageCSigma3LiftObligation.lean:54 with a fine-grained locator (three-term recurrences and Casoratian positivity, section 7.7 Askey-Wilson), but there is NO copy of that textbook anywhere in uploads/, so the locator is not backed by any local source and never was - this upload does not supply it. On merits the actual document is directly in scope: it gives connection formulae between 0 and infinity for the Ramanujan function, the q-Airy function and the divergent 2phi0(0,0;-;q,x), via two distinct q-Borel-Laplace transformations. The corpus has an active q-Airy / q-Borel-Laplace / q-Gevrey programme - QOU/Mathlib/QGevreyOrder.lean, QGevreyTaming.lean, QOU/MathlibExt/QBorelKernelLevel.lean, QOU/QBeta/C1FuchsianExponents.lean - and its existing q-Airy A_q reference is registered at metadata-verification level only.

keyResults.statement: Connection formulae between 0 and infinity for local solutions of the Ramanujan equation (Ramanujan function, q-Airy function, divergent 2phi0), obtained by two distinct q-Borel-Laplace transformations.
